cinematic.note: Painterly at last (the look-neutral framing works) but still daylight; no filmic grade.

cozy.note: Warm lantern glow and golden mist. Cozy finally reads.

epic.note: Warm haze and a tighter waist-up crop; nothing monumental.

nostalgic.note: Warm and bright; a khaki vest. Faint.

peaceful.note: Warm golden mist and calm; warm rather than pale, but serene.

dark.note: Soft daylight. The late fragment cannot turn day into night.

ethereal.note: Sun shafts through the glass, but the figure shrank to the far end of the path.

arcane.note: Golden motes drifting in daylight; magic without the lanterns.

nightshade.note: Blue dusk, lanterns, drifting flakes, dark coat. Gothic and elegant.

golden_hour.note: Warm lantern glow; less sunset than the v1 card.

moonlit.note: Daylight with a stained-glass window. No moon.

festive.note: String lights everywhere, reflections on a wet floor.

after_rain.note: Mild; a damp look at most.
